title: Compass-rose chart of reported directions of flight of flying objects
description: Typed chart titled "REPORTED DIRECTIONS OF FLIGHT" plotting reported object headings along eight compass axes, with arrow ticks along each line and counts at the ends (e.g. NW 63, N 38, S 34, E 22, SE 22, SW 14, NE 9, W 5). A tally at lower left lists "Circling 15, Straight down 3, Direction Indefinite 64, Direction Not Stated 61". A note states that where an undetermined number of objects were reported, the minimum number is plotted, and the same object reported by different people is shown once.
